# Run book: Render a text template

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/render-a-template.md) | [Spec](../specs/render-a-template.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

Generate emails, pages and documents from files named after template, target type and engine, so content changes without code changes.

## Preconditions

- The example stack is running.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Render a text template"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/content/templates`:

1. **See the supported template types.** On load the screen asks the API which template formats it supports. Expect: The supported types list is shown.
2. **Apply the template.** Give the template name and its data, then apply it. Expect: The rendered output appears under Output.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No supported types listed | The template folder is wrong | Check FileTemplatingOptions:TemplatePath and that the files are copied to the output |
| Placeholders stay unreplaced | The model property names differ from the template variables | Match the JSON property names to the template |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Text.Templating.
